articles.title: USAG Hawaii DPW releases lead service line inventory public notification
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Garrison (USAG) Hawaii has updated the Lead Service Line Inventories. (LSLI) required by U.S. EPA’s Lead and Copper Rule Revisions for its water systems and are now available for review. The deadline for the inventories update is October 16, 2026.

articles.title: USS San Antonio (LPD 17) Returns to Norfolk from Deployment to U.S. 4th Fleet Area of Operations
articles.summary: NAVAL STATION NORFOLK, Vir. – The first-in-class amphibious transport dock USS San Antonio (LPD 17) returned to Naval Station Norfolk, Oct. 13, 2026, concluding a dynamic deployment to the U.S. 4th Fleet area of operations.

articles.title: Navy Establishes Seabee Training and Evaluation Unit (STEU) 1 to Drive Pacific Force Readiness
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy officially commissioned Seabee Training and Evaluation Unit (STEU) 1 during a ceremony on board Naval Base Ventura County, Port Hueneme, Calif., Oct. 16, 2026.

articles.title: “The Commandant’s Own” Marks Transition of Leadership, Drum Major Relief and Appointment
articles.summary: WASHINGTON — “The Commandant’s Own” United States Marine Drum & Bugle Corps marked a transition in enlisted leadership as Master Gunnery Sgt. Joshua Dannemiller relinquished his duties as the unit’s 26th drum major to Master Gunnery Sgt. David Cox during a relief and appointment ceremony at Marine Barracks Washington, Oct. 16, 2026.

articles.title: Construction Battalion Maintenance Unit 303 Disestablished After Decades of Expeditionary Excellence
articles.summary: U.S. Navy Sailors, veterans and naval leaders gathered on board Naval Base Ventura County, Port Hueneme, to formally disestablish Construction Battalion Maintenance Unit (CBMU) 303 during a ceremony held in Needham Theater, Oct. 16, 2026.

articles.title: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated

articles.title: Army Lays Out New Plan for Prolonged Fight in First Island Chain
articles.summary: The U.S. Army laid out its plans to prepare for a prolonged fight in the Pacific along the First Island Chain in the service’s new warfighting guidance released this month. For decades, the ground branch has oriented troops against insurgent threats and high-intensity combat operations from the Middle East, Europe and the Korean Peninsula.
